prompt: Build a 4x3 phone keypad: set a GridLayout(4, 3) on the panel and add twelve JButtons for the keys 1-9, *, 0, # in order.
explanation: GridLayout carves the container into equal cells and places components row by row in the exact order they are added, so the KEYS array order fully determines the keypad shape. A for-each loop that does add(new JButton(key)) is all the wiring needed -- the layout manager owns the positioning. getComponent(int) later retrieves children in that same insertion order, which is what the tests rely on.
hints: GridLayout positions components in the order you add them: left to right, top to bottom.
for (String key : KEYS) { add(new JButton(key)); } adds all twelve buttons.
